title: Raster
description: A song title set in letters drawn only from horizontal and vertical strokes with 45-degree corners, sitting on the dot raster they are built from. Drag up or down and the raster refines or coarsens, from five cells across a letter to twenty, and every stroke slides on a spring to the nearest cells of the new grid, so the word rebuilds itself and stays readable at every resolution. Type to change the title.
intent: After Wim Crouwel's New Alphabet (1967), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Alphabet, and his Vormgevers poster grid: accept the raster completely and let the letterforms come from it. Own glyphs, not the font.
